summary: Production-ready solution with excellent YAML/Python practices. Workflow uses pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, proper job dependencies, and `set -euo pipefail`. Python code has clean error handling (MatrixError), proper exit codes, and meaningful validation messages. Integration harness is sophisticated (temp git repos, fixture injection, output parsing). Minor gaps: Python lacks explicit type hints; regex parsing of act output (lines 111-119 in run_act_tests.py) is fragile; test case expected values hardcoded rather than generated. Overall well-executed end-to-end testing through act with clear seams between concerns.
